# Deformable skin mesh

Query target: `DEFORMABLE_SKIN_MESH`. These are static capabilities; the live session decides which objects and operations are available. See [session semantics](../data_model.md) and [write behavior](../writable.md).

Shapes describe tensor dimensions; lanes describe the tuple width, not an extra dimension. Ordering is row-major unless stated otherwise. **CPU** means host memory; **scene device** means CPU on CPU/readback scenes or CUDA on DirectGPU; **CUDA** requires CUDA. Symbolic sizes come from the live group.

| Attribute | Access | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| [points](#points) | read | current skinned vertex positions |

## points

`f32`; units: [distance](units.md#length); frame: skin-mesh-local; semantic: point.

| Access | Layout | Memory |
|---|---|---|
| Read | array, shape [elements], 3 lanes | scene device |

**Read:** requires [DirectGPU warmup](#directgpu-warmup), [Skin mesh](#skin-mesh).

## Conditions

### DirectGPU warmup

Device-backed DirectGPU state requires a completed first step; a write never warms the simulation automatically.

### Skin mesh

Skinned vertices require a CUDA context; skinning is a GPU post-solve step with no CPU twin. Read membership follows skin meshes with skinned vertices, scoped by the owning body.
